import_as_new_project.why: import_excel (and POST /api/io/import/excel) refuses the PyPSA Studio input workbook (owner decision IMPORT-FLOW-1): it is previewed and imported as a new project, never over the open network. Nothing changed; the model says the user imports it as a new project from the app, since chat cannot preview it yet (excel-input-workbook issue 06).

import_write_failed.why: POST /api/workbook/import or POST /api/model-import/import checked its files but could not write the new project's files (a disk or permission failure). The row and the folder it made are removed, so nothing was created; the model says the import did not happen and suggests trying again.

excel_workbook_unavailable.why: The Excel input workbook routes (template, preview, import, a project's workbook) and import_excel answer 503 in a build that does not carry gridspine's workbook reader and writer. Nothing changed; the model says this build cannot read or write the input workbook and offers another import format.

saved_solver_config_unreadable.why: GET /api/projects/{name}/workbook refuses (422) a project whose saved solver_config.json cannot be read, since the workbook carries its solver settings. Nothing changed; the model says the project's solver settings need fixing or re-saving before the workbook can be downloaded.

saved_time_series_unreadable.why: GET /api/projects/{name}/workbook refuses (422) a project whose saved user_ts.json cannot be read, since the workbook carries its uploaded time series. Nothing changed; the model says that file is damaged and the workbook cannot be downloaded until it is fixed or the series are uploaded again.

invalid_project_folder.why: Creating, renaming or importing a project refuses (400) a name whose project folder would resolve outside the projects folder (or onto it), a barrier behind the name sanitiser. Nothing was created; the model asks for a different project name.
